items.title: Vertiv CEO: How Google, Meta, Microsoft earnings are 'reinforcing' data center acceleration

items.title: Nebius Soars 27%, CoreWeave Jumps 24%, Oracle Climbs 7% as AI Cloud Names Snap Back
